name: Intune-App-Sandbox
description: Intune-App-Sandbox is a testing utility for PowerShell-based installers packaged with the Win32 Content Prep Tool for Intune deployments. It creates a sandbox workspace (C:\SandboxEnvironment), and adds context-menu options to pack with IntunewinUtil or run tests in a Safe sandbox. It also supports a detection-based test flow and a reusable template script to accelerate building and validating packaging for Win32 apps in Intune.
author: Maciej Horbacz

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall assessment: The Intune-App-Sandbox tooling appears to be a packaging/testing harness for Windows Sandbox/Intune Win32 apps. While many patterns are legitimate for isolated testing (decoding installers, running in a sandbox, and exporting installation data), there are notable security concerns: apparent obfuscation in the module manifest, deliberate execution policy bypass, and scheduled-task-based SYSTEM execution to run decoded payloads. These patterns warrant strict input validation (trust boundaries for decoded packages), least-privilege usage, and thorough signing/auditing of all inputs to prevent abuse. No explicit hardcoded secrets or external credential handling were detected, but the payload decoding/execution flow represents a potential risk if untrusted packages are supplied.
